profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NASDAQ: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site presents services and platforms aimed at CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, covering areas including Zero Trust implementation, cloud workload security, hybrid workforce protection, and threat intelligence consulting.

The company's AI product tracked by this site is Palo Alto Networks Precision AI, positioned as a network security AI offering with Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response, and coverage for critical infrastructure. The company's site also references the Strata Network Security Platform, described as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI to monitor, analyze, and prevent threats in real time, as well as an AI-driven SecOps platform built on unified data and automation. A product called Idira is introduced on the site as a next-generation identity security platform intended to secure identities for AI enterprise environments.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Palo Alto Networks at this time.
